hook: British map just placed Fort Albion on Tangier Island.

sections.voiceover: British map just placed Fort Albion on Tangier Island.
sections.visual_cue: Close‑up of the newly discovered British map highlighting Fort Albion on Tangier Island.

sections.voiceover: Tangier Island sits low in Chesapeake Bay, Virginia. What does the burial ground reveal about the enslaved defenders?
sections.visual_cue: Map overlay showing Fort Albion location; aerial view of Tangier Island; question mark over a burial‑ground illustration.

sections.voiceover: But the map also marks a burial ground of formerly enslaved fighters.
sections.visual_cue: Zoom on the map to a burial‑ground icon beside Fort Albion.

sections.voiceover: Archaeologists found a burial ground, proving enslaved fighters defended Fort Albion. The graves sit on Tangier Island, the exact location the map revealed. PBS aired it in season 23, episode 7 of Secrets of the Dead.
sections.visual_cue: Excavation footage of graves; map pinpointing the site; PBS logo with season 23, episode 7 badge.

sections.voiceover: The buried fighters finally have their story told.
sections.visual_cue: Sunset over Tangier Island with silhouettes of soldiers fading into the horizon.
